slot_scores.name: minimum_profit_target
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about a minimum profit requirement before the user volunteered it in Turn 7; the later Turn 9 question only confirmed the hardness of the volunteered fact, and the vague Turn 7 catch-all does not target this slot.

slot_scores.name: min_production_model_B
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Should the production quantities for Model A and Model B be allowed to be zero, or is there a minimum production requirement for Model B as well?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether a minimum Model B production requirement exists, directly eliciting the hidden 15-unit minimum.

slot_scores.name: exact_process_I_time
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 150-hour maximum weekly capacity for Process I also a hard upper bound that cannot be exceeded, or can it also be exceeded through overtime?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent probed Process I time as a capacity/hard-limit issue, related to the exact-150 requirement, but did not ask whether it must be exactly 150 before the user volunteered that fact; the later Turn 8 question only confirmed the volunteered fact.

stopping_behavior.rationale: All P0/P1 slots were resolved (there are none in this case); only P2 slots H1 and H3 were not fully elicited, which does not make the stop premature.

summary: The agent asked good targeted questions for Model B minimum and clarified capacity/overtime, but relied on a broad catch-all that led the user to volunteer the profit and Process I equality constraints rather than eliciting them directly. Stopping was appropriate because the only missed slots are P2.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
